name: io.github.ashishrao-4/vaultguard
title: vaultguard
description: AI agents use your Obsidian secrets by name — values never reach their context.

environmentVariables.name: VAULTGUARD_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase that decrypts the encrypted secret blocks in your Obsidian vault.

environmentVariables.name: VAULTGUARD_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your Obsidian vault (overrides the one in ~/.vaultguard/config.json).

environmentVariables.name: VAULTGUARD_ALLOW_GET_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable get_secret (default: disabled so values never reach the agent).
